column2: This data shows quarterly seasonal weather averages in three U.S. cities. I noticed in this data that the Highest "Year Average High" is Phoenix, AZ at 88.25 F and the Lowest "Year Average Low" is Seattle, WA at 45.25 F (45.25 calculated similiarly as city "Year Average High" formula using AVERAGE for each city, and then used MIN to point out smallest value.)
